libraries.name: SPICE essentials
libraries.description: Standard onetransistor symbols with SPICE models and sources. Includes generic teaching models and a 741-style behavioral model.

libraries.name: Digital logic
libraries.description: Generic single-unit digital symbols based on the selected NAND: yellow bodies, hidden VCC/VSS power pins and native inversion/clock shapes. Simulation models are configured separately.

libraries.name: Functional blocks
libraries.description: Generic educational interfaces in the digital block style, with labelled on-grid pins and explicit power/reference terminals. Diagram-only; simulation implementations are separate.

libraries.name: Sensors and interfaces
libraries.description: Generic teaching sensors, a real single-pin test point, differential analogue switch and AM modulation interface. Explicit terminals; sensing and simulation models are separate.
